# Paths fed to BOTH check-stubs implementations' --classify/-Classify mode, WITH
# the verdict each one must return. The format is exactly what --classify prints:
#
#     source <path>     this file's markers count toward the ratchet
#     skip   <path>     this file is not shipped behaviour
#
# tests/framework-checks.sh strips the verdict column to build the input, runs
# both implementations, and diffs their output against THIS FILE.
#
# One path per line. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored. The
# files do not have to exist -- classification is a decision about the PATH. Paths
# containing spaces do not belong here: `--classify` takes a word list and
# `-Classify` takes a comma-separated string, so neither can carry one. The
# enumeration of such paths is covered by the planted-count check instead.
#
# WHY THE VERDICT IS WRITTEN DOWN. The two implementations were first compared by
# diffing their marker regexes, which are identical and always were; the
# disagreement lived in the file filter next to them. Comparing the two ANSWERS
# fixed that and introduced a subtler version of the same defect: parity is
# agreement, not correctness. Gutting `is_source` in BOTH implementations so that
# nothing at all is classified as source left the suite fully green -- two
# implementations agreeing perfectly about nothing. An expected verdict is the
# only thing neither implementation gets a vote on.
#
# Add the path that disagreed here BEFORE fixing the disagreement.

# --- ordinary source: counted --------------------------------------------
source src/app.ts
source src/Api/Program.cs
source main.go
source lib/util.rb
source Makefile
source src/latest/run.ts
source src/testify-helpers/README.rs
source build-tools/gen.py

# --- `test` as a SUBSTRING is not a test file (G7) ------------------------
# `git mv src/ledger.ts src/latest-ledger.ts` took the count from 1 to 0 on both
# implementations. A rename is not a code review event, so anyone could walk
# through that hole without meaning to.
source src/latest-ledger.ts
source protest.go
source contest.rb
source Greatest.cs
source attestation.ts
source Testing.cs

# --- ...and as a WORD it is, however the language spells it ---------------
skip src/order_test.go
skip src/test_order.py
skip src/OrderTests.cs
skip src/UserSpec.scala
skip src/order-tests.js
skip Test.cs

# --- the checker itself: never counted ------------------------------------
skip check-stubs.sh
skip check-stubs.ps1
skip tooling/gate/check-stubs.sh
skip tooling/gate/check-stubs.ps1
